children: Diversified Energy Company (NYSE: DEC, LSE: DEC) (“Diversified” or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the Company plans to publish its operational and financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (the “third quarter results”) on Wednesday, November 4th, 2026, after the U.S. market close. The Company will host a conference call at 8:30 AM EST (1:30 PM GMT) on Thursday, November 5th to discuss the third quarter 2026 results and make an audio replay of the event available shortly thereafter.
Prior to the event, Diversified will publish the Company’s third quarter results on its website at
and make available a supplementary second quarter results Presentation at https://ir.div.energy/presentations.
Senior Vice President, Investor Relations & Corporate Communications

Diversified is a leading publicly traded energy company focused on acquiring, operating, and optimizing cash-generating energy assets. Through our unique differentiated strategy, we acquire existing, long-life assets and invest in them to improve environmental and operational performance until retiring those assets in a safe and environmentally secure manner. Recognized by ratings agencies and organizations for our sustainability leadership, this solutions-oriented, stewardship approach makes Diversified the Right Company at the Right Time to responsibly produce energy, deliver reliable free cash flow, and generate shareholder value.

title: Diversified Energy Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Results
